title: Add invoice PDF download endpoint
description: Adds GET api/invoices/{id}/pdf so customers can download invoices from the portal.

expected_issues.description: The invoice is loaded by id alone. Unlike `List`, there is no `TenantId == _currentUser.TenantId` check, so any signed-in user can download any tenant's invoice by iterating ids (IDOR). Filter by tenant and return 404 otherwise.
